name: Close All MT5
summary: A utility Expert Advisor for MT5 that closes all open positions and/or pending orders on the account. It provides a quick one-click or automatic mechanism to liquidate all trades, typically used as an emergency exit or end-of-day cleanup tool.
summary_zh: 一个MT5实用工具EA，用于关闭账户上所有未平仓位和/或挂单。提供一键或自动清算所有交易的机制，通常用作紧急退出或日内收尾工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个交易策略，而是一个账户管理工具。它的核心功能是遍历账户中所有未平仓头寸和挂单，然后逐一关闭或删除。入场条件不适用，因为此工具不主动开仓。出场条件即用户触发关闭操作或满足预设的自动关闭条件（如达到特定盈利/亏损阈值）。仓位管理方面，该工具不涉及仓位建立，只涉及仓位的批量清算。资金管理方面，部分此类工具提供按盈利目标或亏损限额自动全平的功能，起到资金保护作用。整体而言，这是一个风险控制辅助工具，在紧急行情或账户达到盈亏目标时帮助交易者快速退出市场。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but an account management utility. Its core function iterates through all open positions and pending orders on the account, closing or deleting them one by one. Entry conditions are not applicable since this tool does not initiate trades. Exit conditions are triggered by user action or preset automatic conditions such as reaching a specific profit or loss threshold. In terms of position management, the tool does not build positions but only handles bulk liquidation of existing ones. For money management, some variants provide automatic close-all functionality based on profit targets or drawdown limits, serving as a capital protection mechanism. Overall, this is a risk controlauxiliary tool that helps traders quickly exit the market during emergency market conditions or when account profit/loss targets are reached.

parameters.name: Target Profit
parameters.description: 达到目标盈利时自动全平（货币单位）
parameters.description_en: Auto close all at target profit (currency units)

parameters.name: Target Loss
parameters.description: 达到目标亏损时自动全平（货币单位）
parameters.description_en: Auto close all at target loss (currency units)

parameters.name: Close Pending Orders
parameters.description: 是否同时删除所有挂单

parameters.name: Magic Number
parameters.description: 指定EA魔术号过滤，-1为全部
parameters.description_en: EA magic number filter, -1 for all

pros: 一键全平功能在极端行情下能快速止损保护资金
支持按盈利/亏损目标自动触发全平，实现自动化资金管理
可按魔术号筛选关闭特定EA的仓位，不影响其他策略
操作简单直观，适合新手和需要快速反应的交易场景
pros_en: One-click close-all provides rapid capital protection during extreme market conditions
Automatic trigger by profit/loss targets enables hands-off money management
Magic number filtering allows selective closing of specific EA positions without affecting other strategies
Simple and intuitive operation suitable for beginners and scenarios requiring quick reaction
cons: 全平操作不可逆，误操作可能导致不必要的仓位关闭和损失
在流动性差的市场中批量关闭可能产生显著滑点成本
缺乏部分平仓或分批平仓的灵活性，无法精细控制退出节奏
频繁市价全平可能被经纪商标记为异常交易行为
cons_en: Close-all operation is irreversible; accidental triggering can cause unnecessary position closures and losses
Batch closing in low-liquidity markets may incur significant slippage costs
Lacks flexibility for partial or staggered closing, unable to finely control exit pacing
Frequent market-order close-all may be flagged as unusual trading activity by brokers
improvements: 增加确认对话框或双重触发机制防止误操作全平
添加分批平仓功能，按仓位大小或盈亏排序逐步关闭以降低滑点影响
加入声音提示和推送通知，在自动全平触发时及时告知交易者
improvements_en: Add confirmation dialog or dual-trigger mechanism to prevent accidental close-all execution
Implement staggered closing functionality, sorting by position size or P&L to reduce slippage impact
Add sound alerts and push notifications to promptly inform traders when auto close-all is triggered

risk_points: 误操作全平可能导致不必要仓位被关闭
自动全平在剧烈波动时可能因滑点导致实际亏损超过预设阈值
risk_points_en: Accidental close-all execution may close positions unnecessarily
Auto close-all during extreme volatility may result in actual loss exceeding the preset threshold due to slippage

summary_en: A utility Expert Advisor for MT5 that closes all open positions and/or pending orders on the account. It provides a quick one-click or automatic mechanism to liquidate all trades, typically used as an emergency exit or end-of-day cleanup tool.
